title: APP rank-space adjacent-pair interaction
hypothesis: The five numbers' APP ranks may contain pairwise adjacency structure beyond the individual rank-sum signal tested in Q135. A fixed-size exponential-family model with an adjacent-rank interaction should improve exact subset log-likelihood and marginal-inclusion Brier score over the Q135 rank-only model on later chronological targets.

feature.adjacent_rank_pairs: A(S)=sum_{i=1}^{4} I(r_(i+1)-r_(i)=1), for sorted selected ranks
feature.distinction: Adjacency is in APP rank space, not numeric-value space; it is not Q128's consecutive-number feature.

model.normalizer: Z(beta,gamma)=sum over all 658008 five-rank subsets, enumerated exactly
model.marginal_inclusion: p_r=sum_{S contains r} P_{beta,gamma}(S), computed by the same exact enumeration

selection.objective: maximize mean exact subset log-likelihood gain versus Q135 rank-only comparator

walk_forward.strict_prior_rule: Each source row's history_cutoff must equal the previous UTC calendar date; source ledger is pinned to Q123 and ends 2026-11-10.
walk_forward.scoring: Score target before any target update; Q136 has no adaptive updates.

inference.conditional_randomization: Uniform 5-of-40 rank subsets; 10000 replicate sequences per holdout split; same sampled subset sequence scored against all 12 candidates.
inference.bootstrap: 10000 circular block-bootstrap replicates, block length 20, for all 12 Blind OOS candidate comparisons.

directions.log_likelihood_gain: upper tail; positive favors interaction model
directions.brier_delta: lower tail; negative favors interaction model

limitations: The exploratory calculation preceded this written protocol; Q136 is not preregistered or confirmatory.
Q136 is a post-hoc extension of Q135 and reuses Q123's APP rank ledger; it is not independent evidence.
The historical Blind OOS has been exposed to prior SONAR research and is not a virgin holdout.
Holm corrects the 48 Q136 holdout endpoints only, not the full Q00-Q135 research family.
The null assumes independent uniform 5-of-40 draws.
The disputed 2026-11-11 result is excluded; no Q60, canonical archive, freeze, or production scorer is changed.
next_action: Keep Q135 unchanged. Do not promote pairwise rank interactions. Continue source-clean prospective collection and resolve contest 315 provenance before evaluating dependent freezes.
